source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check Mini DP can work with resolution change
1.Power on SUT and boot into OS.
2.Change the current video resolution and color depth to better.
3.Choose the "Test" button to test the changes, then choose "Apply" to accept the changes.
4.Shutdown and restart the OS, then login.
5.Review Event Viewer logs to confirm there are no errors or fault conditions reported.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1.All selectable changes up to 3840 x 2160 at a 16bit color depth should function properly. Higher resolutions may not work properly because of limitations of the video driver used and the supported resolutions of the monitor used.
2.Screen can display w/o error.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Resolution change up - 3840 x 2160x16bit: change the Mini-DP video resolution/color depth up to 3840x2160@16bit in the OS display settings. Requires a person at the display + OS desktop GUI (Test -> Apply); agent can read the current mode with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "xrandr 2>&1 | grep -iE 'connected|\*' | head 2>&1" if a GUI session is present, but the GUI change + visual confirmation are operator/visual.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the xrandr/DRM mode list so the user confirms 3840x2160@16bit applied properly on the Mini-DP display; the GUI apply + visual check are operator.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: resolution change is a GUI/visual check on the Mini-DP display - operator performs it; agent only reads the OS mode.

original_test_intent: Verify all approved selectable MiniDP modes through 3840x2160 at the source-defined 16-bit colour depth, with a visible error-free 4K image, persistence through restart/login and no display/driver faults.
original_method: An engineer applies the approved UHD-and-lower matrix through the OS GUI Test/Apply path, visually inspects the physical MiniDP display, restarts and logs in, then reviews Event Viewer and supporting logs.
manual_activity: The engineer must use GUI Test/Apply and visually judge image presence, stability and artifacts at every approved mode through 3840x2160, then confirm restart/login recovery.
required_inputs: OS build and display GUI workflow
GPU/driver, MiniDP output/cable and monitor/EDID with 4K bandwidth capability
16-bit colour, refresh/timing and all-selectable mode matrix through 3840x2160
Maintenance approval, physical display operator, known-good revert mode and alternate console
safety_requirements: Do not apply an unadvertised 4K timing, refresh or depth.
Verify the whole link's bandwidth and keep independent KVM/console recovery.
Treat GUI change and restart as service-impacting and preserve Event Viewer/system logs.
Stop on blanking, link training failure, corruption, driver reset or failed login; do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Collect OS-native GPU/driver, EDID, link, mode/depth and event data for each approved change.
Track UHD-and-lower coverage and the restart timeline.
Compare logs and electronic state while leaving visual quality and verdict to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Approve the 4K mode/depth/refresh matrix and recovery.
Perform GUI Test/Apply, visually inspect each mode and execute restart/login.
Review all visual and log evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not sufficient or platform-neutral. xrandr is Linux-specific while the source references Event Viewer, and a current-mode query cannot prove Test/Apply, 16-bit colour, 4K image integrity or persistence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented OS-native read-only EDID/link/mode and event collection after platform identification; do not automate a 4K setting change without proven recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All modes through 3840x2160, 16-bit colour, GUI Test/Apply, restart/login, Event Viewer and 10/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: PLATFORM METHOD PENDING; RETAIN HUMAN 4K VISUAL CORE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build the matrix from EDID and project requirements, record link/mode/depth after each GUI application, photograph a 4K diagnostic pattern for scaling/artifacts, restart once at the final mode and export display/driver events.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact OS, GPU/driver, MiniDP link and 4K monitor.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS build, GPU firmware/driver and monitor EDID.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner display specification and OS/GPU/monitor supported-mode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds bandwidth/link identity and per-mode evidence without replacing human inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No lower mode is removed and no unsupported depth/refresh is inferred.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Electronic readback may show 3840x2160 while visible artifacts, scaling or link instability remain.

project_override_considerations: A project may define refresh rates and which advertised modes count as selectable. Any reduced matrix is reported only as that approved plan. Missing parameters are readiness inputs, not permanent BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: OS/GPU/driver/MiniDP/cable/monitor/EDID identities and approved UHD matrix
Per-mode GUI result, electronic readback and timestamped visual 4K evidence
Successful restart/login with final approved mode
Event Viewer/system/BMC/SEL review, restoration status and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The 3840x2160 mode, visual, restart and log requirements are consistent; missing depth/refresh details are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The method is clear. Platform capability and mode values determine readiness but do not permanently block the case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject PARTIAL and xrandr-only coverage; retain readback only after OS confirmation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its 4K bandwidth/EDID and recovery analysis while applying MANUAL ONLY to the visual/GUI core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds 4K link-training and artifact boundaries while preserving every lower selectable mode.

review_improvement: Prevents a 4K mode string from being mistaken for validated bandwidth, image integrity, colour depth, restart persistence and clean Event Viewer results.
independent_technical_reasoning: At 3840x2160 the machine can inventory the negotiated mode, but only a human can execute the required GUI path and confirm the physical image has no visible error. The core is MANUAL ONLY.
